title: There Is Power In The Blood
firstLine: Would you be free from your burden of sin?

lines: Would you be free from your burden of sin?
There's pow'r in the blood, pow'r in the blood;
Would you o'er evil in a victory win?
There's wonderful pow'r in the blood.
Would you be free from your passion and pride?
There's pow'r in the blood, pow'r in the blood;
Come for a cleansing to Calvary's tide,
There's wonderful pow'r in the blood.
Would you do service for Jesus your King?
pow'r in the blood; Would you live daily, His praises to sing?
There's wonderful pow'r in the blood.
There is pow'r, pow'r, wonder working pow'r
In the blood of the Lamb;
There is pow'r, pow'r, wonder working pow'r
In the precious blood of the Lamb.
